description: parity-interaction-engine's log events (log-record.v1, parity-contracts CONVENTIONS "Logging"). Every IE log call names one of these (or a common one) in `event`; ci.sh checks the records its tests capture with contract-check. Call-scoped records carry the xsid (the interaction id, a UUIDv7) and the number map's tenant.

agent.connected.description: The agent's leg answered and routing-engine recorded CONNECTED.

agent.wrap_up_ended.description: routing-engine: the agent's wrap-up ended (attrs.agent_id, reservation_id).

arrival.dropped.description: An arrival was dropped: the arrivals channel is full.

arrival.redirect_failed.description: A redirect failed: the arrival is refused instead.

call.arrival_lost.description: The telephony client no longer holds the arrival this replica claimed.

call.arrived.description: TC offered an arrival to this replica (attrs: masked numbers, the flow). Not call-scoped: a number outside the map has no tenant.

call.claim_taken.description: Another owner holds the interaction in etcd: this replica sends nothing.

call.declined.description: The arrival was refused (attrs.sip_status): an unknown number, another tenant's, no etcd lease.

call.ending_stuck.description: The call waited in Ending over 5 min for TC's end; the owner key is kept (an operator's case, IE-056).

call.mailbox_closed.description: The session's mailbox closed (fenced, or the node declared dead).

call.tenant_mismatch.description: X-Tenant-ID disagreed with the number map: the call is refused and alerted.

cdr.schema_applied.description: The CDR schema is applied (local profiles only).

cdr.write_lost.description: A CDR write was lost (the queue was full, or Postgres refused it).

cdr.written.description: A CDR row or snapshot was written (attrs.write: progress, close, orphan; insert-only, idempotent).

consent.decided.description: The recording consent decision (attrs.decision, basis; not_announced: the announcement couldn't be played, IE-068).

drain.completed.description: Draining finished (attrs.drainer, or the drained file).

drain.failed.description: A drain failed or ran out of time: no drained file.

dtmf.action_reported.description: parity-ms acted on an agent's DTMF code (attrs.action, result, recording, muted): never the digits or the code.

etcd.registered.description: This replica registered in etcd (its lease, the replica key).

flow.counted.description: A flow counter moved (attrs.counter: a skipped verb, a retried or skipped prompt, a re-attach, ...).

health_file.failed.description: The healthy file couldn't be written or removed.

interaction.closed_after_restart.description: The end of a call this replica id owned before a restart (kill -9): its CDR closed from TC's end, its agent freed.

interaction.created.description: This replica claimed ie/owner for the call: IE owns it from here (attrs.origin: pstn, agent, api, callback, consult; parent_xsid when another call caused it).

interaction.ended.description: The customer's call ended and its CDR closes (attrs.end_reason, ended_by, queue_outcome, duration_ms).

ivr.input_collected.description: A gather ended: attrs.presses counts keys, attrs.step is the route taken. Digits never appear.

leg.added.description: An agent's leg is placed through TC (attrs.role agent; leg_id is the agent leg's).

leg.dtmf_actions_off.description: The node doesn't list dtmf_actions: the agent's codes are off on this leg.

leg.removed.description: A leg this call placed is hung up (attrs.reason).

leg.updated.description: TC reported a leg's state (attrs.role, state, cause, sip_status).

log.external.description: A record of a library IE uses (component names it); its text in msg.

management.bind_failed.description: The management port can't be bound; retried.

owner.claim_failed.description: The owner claim failed (etcd, or the lease is gone): the arrival is declined.

owner.lease_lost.description: No etcd keepalive worked for a whole TTL (or the lease expired): new calls are declined.

owner.lease_restored.description: A new etcd lease is live, with the replica key: claims resume.

owner.release_failed.description: The owner key couldn't be released (its lease ends it).

owner.released.description: The call's ie/owner key was released.

play.started.description: TC reported a play started (contracts 0.17.0 result_events; attrs.play_id).

play.failed.description: TC reported a play ended without starting (0.17.0 PlayFailed; attrs.play_id, reason): IE-068 retries once or skips; a consent prompt means no recording.

prompt.started.description: A prompt plays to the caller (attrs.prompt_id, play_id, looped).

queue.position_changed.description: routing-engine's position for the entry (attrs.position, expected_wait_s).

recording.confirmed.description: TC's RecordingStarted event for a leg.

recording.disabled.description: Consent allows recording but recordings are off ([recording] mode).

recording.failed.description: TC refused a leg's recording: a consented caller not recorded; the call goes on.

recording.key_failed.description: The OS RNG failed: the recording is not started.

recording.paused.description: The agent paused the recording by DTMF (PCI): no digit anywhere.

recording.requested.description: IE asked TC to record a leg (attrs.recording_id, agent_leg; a null sink until step 9).

recording.resumed.description: The agent resumed the recording by DTMF.

recording.stopped.description: A leg's recording stopped (attrs.duration_ms, pauses, dtmf_pauses, size_bytes).

routing.acks_ignored.description: routing-engine ignored acknowledgements as stale or foreign (attrs.ignored).

routing.call_ended.description: CallEnded answered: the agent's wrap-up starts.

routing.callback_ignored.description: RunCallback isn't handled before step 12: left to RE's redelivery.

routing.caller_gone_reported.description: An Assigned for a call that had ended: CALLER_GONE reported (abandon vs assign).

routing.delivery_rebased.description: MF-1a: routing-engine (restarted without its state) holds nothing of the call and numbers afresh: the binding's delivery sequence restarts from RE's numbering (attrs.previous_next, previous_acked, last_delivery_seq).

routing.endpoint_changed.description: Requests and the stream move to another routing-engine instance (attrs.endpoint).

routing.leader_changed.description: IE-059: routing-engine's leader changed (leader_epoch rose; attrs.from_leader_epoch): calls keep going and re-attach. Never an exit.

routing.leader_learned.description: routing-engine named a leader outside the configured instances: added.

routing.machine_bug.description: A routing request reached the wrong runner or overlapped (a machine bug).

routing.mailbox_full.description: A call's routing mailbox is full or closed: RE redelivers.

routing.message_dropped.description: A routing message was dropped (no target, or another owner epoch).

routing.message_held.description: A routing message past a gap is held back until RE redelivers the missing one (CR-053).

routing.orphaned.description: Routing messages for an interaction this replica doesn't hold (adoption is step 8).

routing.outcome_recorded.description: ReportOutcome answered: what routing-engine recorded first (attrs.reported, recorded).

routing.reattached.description: IE-059: after a leader change the call re-attached (attrs.entry, reservations).

routing.request_refused.description: A routing request without routing or an owner: refused.

routing.request_sent.description: A request to routing-engine is sent (op).

routing.rpc_failed.description: A routing request failed after its retries (op, outcome, error).

routing.rpc_retried.description: A routing request is retried (op, attempt): RE unavailable, or a standby pointed at the leader.

routing.stream_live.description: The Watch stream to routing-engine is live (attrs.endpoint).

routing.stream_lost.description: No routing message within the heartbeat timeout: reconnecting.

routing.stream_superseded.description: Another process watches routing-engine with this replica id: stopped.

routing.tenant_mismatch.description: A routing message names another tenant for this interaction: dropped and alerted.

service.stop_slow.description: A part didn't stop within 1 s at exit.

session.closed_from_tombstone.description: The session closed from TC's tombstone: its end never reached its owner.

session.degraded.description: The session's owner is not keeping up with its events.

session.end_dropped.description: An orphan's end was dropped: the events channel is full.

session.end_record_failed.description: The ENDED record failed: TC's end isn't acknowledged and is replayed.

session.ended.description: TC's SessionEnded for the call (attrs.reason, sip_status).

session.event_ignored.description: A telephony event the flow doesn't use (attrs.kind).

session.fenced.description: A newer owner has the session.

session.gone.description: TC no longer has the session on a live node: it ended.

session.orphaned.description: Events for a session this replica doesn't hold (adoption is step 8).

session.reconcile_asked.description: Ending waited past its deadline for TC's end: TC was asked (attrs.found).

session.resynced.description: TC's snapshot replaced IE's view of the session.

session.snapshot_ignored.description: An older telephony snapshot was ignored.

session.unmanaged.description: The node's stream is lost: the call keeps its audio, no command and no timer until it is back.

session.zombie_ended.description: IE had ended the session as dead while TC still had it live: ended.

signal.received.description: A signal (attrs.signal): the first drains, a second exits at once.

telephony.acks_not_durable.description: SessionEnded acknowledgements aren't durable until step 8 (MemoryEndedLog).

telephony.arrivals_toggled.description: New arrivals are taken or paused (attrs.accepting: false while there is no etcd lease, IE-055).

telephony.clock_skewed.description: A media node's clock is off by more than 100 ms (attrs.skew_ms).

telephony.command_failed.description: TC refused a command as a bug (attrs.command, code).

telephony.command_not_done.description: A command to TC didn't succeed (attrs.command, outcome).

telephony.command_unknown.description: A telephony command's result is unknown (attrs.reconciled).

telephony.event_dropped.description: A telephony event names another node: dropped.

telephony.intent_refused.description: A telephony command was refused before it was sent (attrs.command, rule).

telephony.node_declared_dead.description: A media node was declared dead on evidence: its sessions are ended.

telephony.node_lost.description: A media node's stream is lost: its sessions are unmanaged (they keep their audio).

telephony.node_restarted.description: A media node has a new incarnation: its sessions are resynced.

telephony.stream_silent.description: A media node's stream was silent past its liveness.

telephony.stream_superseded.description: Another process uses this replica id on a node's stream: readiness failed.
